steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hi there, this is Nino Sama's live stream channel! It's not my usual streaming time now, so consider yourselves lucky to catch me at this hour!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: In fact... This is a surprise live stream! Surprise! This is Nino Sama's mercy to you!
Nino searches for words nervously, trying her best to get in character.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ahem, although it's a bit rushed, I've decided to stream this ancient game called Lord of War... or something like that.
After her usual introduction, she starts running the game while checking the reactions in the live chat.
As always, comments keep popping up non-stop. But looking at those words, Nino feels that something is off.
Nino frowns. People are always looking for entertainment from her live streams and most audience are here for a show. Very few comments focus on Nino herself these days.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: What the hell is going on... I have barely started, and these comments are all over the place...
Or is it... all that woman's doing? How did she get these ancient games, and how did she sneak my computer in here?
Negative emotions detected. Please continue the live stream, otherwise extreme measures will be taken.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: What the **** is this detection system? Stop bothering me or I'll give you a punch...
Suddenly, a barrage of comments appears before her eyes. "Girls shouldn't swear." "Just cut the crap and play the game!" "Love it, keep talking!" Nino feels dizzy.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Huh... What's this about... This is the way I've always been. You guys have never said anything!
Anger detected. Do not argue with the audience. Please continue the live stream, otherwise extreme measures will be taken.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Shut the **** up! Who the hell are you to tell me how to host my live stream?!
Anger detected. Do not argue with the audience. Please continue the live stream, otherwise extreme measures will be taken.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Now you've really pissed me off. Bite me!
Nino punches the screen in front of her. For a moment, the entire live chat system seems to glitch, flickering several times.
Then, the interface goes blank completely, like the system's rebooting.
Live stream countdown, three, two, one...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Nasty system... Ahem! Took me a while to load the game just now. Let me tell you, this is a game I worked so hard to get from the DisCity Prehistory Museum. You should be grateful I'm streaming it for free!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I've heard that the production level of games back then was quite something. You guys better watch closely!
